steps.objective: Diagnose why GAMBIT's Doctor dashboard 'Run checks' flashes briefly and then settles into a red/failed last-run badge with no checks rendered. Two confirmed evidence anchors pre-supplied: (1) real `eidolons doctor` output uses a category-grouped format (=== Foo ===) with the status glyph at the START of each line and ~30 checks total — NOT the [N/M]-prefixed 9-check shape the existing parser expects; (2) macOS GUI apps inherit a minimal PATH (/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin) that does not include ~/.local/bin where the user's `eidolons` lives. Determine which is the primary trigger, and whether both fixes are required.
Apply the patch identified in VIGIL's root-cause-report so the Doctor 'Run checks' button produces a populated, accurate health grid.
